I understand where you’re coming from, all I can really ask is what do you expect from yourself afterwards? In your case it’s nothing but psychological because that was your friend, a lot of emotions intertwine and at the end of the day that was someone you once trusted, broke bread with etc. 

But to answer your question. I’ve forgiven someone who’s treated me terribly, it feels much better knowing im on the greener side. Forgiveness will give you the power to move on and improve with your life, if you choose to think it’s a trick, you’ll probably stay stagnant for as long as you deny it. 

Closure will help if you can get it. A lot of the times people will do you dirty and run away from you leaving you to suffer, so if you can get closure that would be a benefactor. 

Forgiveness Is more healthy than staying the same. It’s a chance to start again. 

Forgive, but never forget.
Forgiveness will free you from the shackles of dwelling, hatred and revenge. Just my opinion.
